name: parallax
description: Ask Claude, GPT, Gemini, OpenRouter and local models the same question side by side, or have them discuss it, with your own API keys.

interface.shortDescription: Ask several AI models at once, or let them discuss
interface.longDescription: Parallax sends a prompt to Claude, GPT, Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama and other models in parallel and brings every answer back, or runs a group discussion where the models reply to each other. It uses your own API keys, which stay on your computer: add them with the configure_keys tool, which opens a page in your browser.
defaultPrompt: Ask Claude and Gemini for a second opinion on this plan with Parallax.
Use Parallax to have two models debate the trade-offs here.
Set up my API keys for Parallax.
